title: BECE Basic Science - Basic Science - Biology & Growth
subject: Basic Science

questions.q: The period of rapid growth and sexual maturation in humans is called:
questions.explain: Puberty is the developmental stage where adolescents reach sexual maturity and become capable of reproduction.
questions.subject: Basic Science

questions.q: Which of the following is a secondary sexual characteristic in males?
questions.explain: Deepening of the voice (due to the enlargement of the larynx) is a characteristic change in males during puberty.
questions.subject: Basic Science

questions.q: The transmission of traits from parents to offspring is known as:
questions.explain: Heredity (or genetics) refers to the passing of genetic traits from parents to offspring.
questions.subject: Basic Science

questions.q: An organism's natural dwelling place is called its:
questions.explain: A habitat is the natural environment where an organism lives, grows, and thrives.
questions.subject: Basic Science

questions.q: Which of these is an example of an aquatic habitat?
questions.explain: Aquatic habitats are water-based environments, such as rivers, lakes, and oceans.
questions.subject: Basic Science

questions.q: Which feature helps a fish to breathe in water?
questions.explain: Fish use gills to extract dissolved oxygen from water for respiration.
questions.subject: Basic Science

questions.q: Cactus plants have spines instead of leaves to:
questions.explain: Spines reduce the surface area for transpiration, helping the cactus conserve water in desert environments.
questions.subject: Basic Science

questions.q: Which of the following traits is NOT genetically inherited?
questions.explain: Scars are acquired traits resulting from environmental factors or accidents, not from genetic DNA.
questions.subject: Basic Science

questions.q: Arboreal animals are those that live primarily in:
questions.explain: Arboreal refers to animals (like monkeys or squirrels) that spend most of their time in trees.
questions.subject: Basic Science

questions.q: The union of a male and female gamete is called:
questions.explain: Fertilization is the fusion of sperm (male gamete) and egg (female gamete) to form a zygote.
questions.subject: Basic Science

questions.q: Which of the following is a structural adaptation of a bird for flight?
questions.explain: Birds have hollow (pneumatic) bones to reduce weight, making flight more energy-efficient.
questions.subject: Basic Science

questions.q: Menstruation occurs in females as a result of:
options: The shedding of the uterine lining
The blockage of the fallopian tube
questions.explain: If fertilization does not occur, the lining of the uterus breaks down and is discharged as menstruation.
questions.subject: Basic Science
